notes.title: Developer’s Letter – Thank You for Participating in the Alpha Test
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is the Vindictus: Defying Fate Development Team. [/p][p] [/p][p]The eight-day alpha test has come to an end. We sincerely thank you for your enthusiastic participation and the interest you have shown. [/p][p]We would like to take this opportunity to share some thoughts with all those who participated, regarding the direction we plan to take after this test and some reflections from the development team. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Preparing for the Alpha Test[/b] [/p][p]This alpha test was prepared with the purpose of testing the overall structure of the game along with some specific pieces of content. [/p][p]Unlike the pre-alpha test, this version allows players to experience the tutorial, customize their characters, play in the village after customization, and progress through the story. [/p][p]In addition, we applied systems such as the Follower system that supports combat, newly designed combat areas, co-op boss battles, and the Fitting Room feature. [/p][p]Since this was a test version, many systems were still in early and mid-development stages. However, we aimed to verify the basic gameplay cycle based on a structure that was mostly in place.[/p][p]Throughout this process, we were fortunate to receive encouraging support from our players, as well as honest criticism and valuable feedback. Once again, we sincerely thank you. [/p][p]Since the feedback was shaped by each player’s unique experiences and perspectives, we received a truly diverse range of opinions, and naturally, many of them conflicted with each other. [/p][p]Even so, we believe that much of your feedback converged on three key points. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Key Areas for Improvement[/b] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]• First: Optimization[/b] [/p][p]The most commonly raised issue was optimization. [/p][p]We fully acknowledge that poor optimization was entirely due to our shortcomings as a development team, regardless of the engine or any other circumstances. [/p][p]Of course, part of the purpose of this test was to identify issues like this, but it is true that the optimization was excessively poor, and it seems this led to many cases where the gameplay experience was significantly damaged. [/p][p]There were numerous instances where low frame rates or sudden lags caused necessary controls to fail at the intended timing, which made the combat experience feel frustrating and unpleasant. [/p][p]We are truly sorry if you had a bad experience due to these optimization issues. [/p][p]This experience will serve as a valuable lesson for our development team, and we will work hard to deliver much better optimization in future builds. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]• Second: Combat Direction[/b] [/p][p]Many players commented that the repeated playstyle of aiming for short attacks during brief openings after enemy attacks made the combat style feel frustrating. [/p][p]Along with this, the slow pace of transitioning between attacking, dodging, guarding, and moving led to a lack of freedom, and many said the action style strongly felt heavy and overly restricted. [/p][p]There were also opinions that even seemingly light hits quickly led to incapacitation, and that situations like the limited number of Flovian Flasks continued to cause discomfort. [/p][p]In these circumstances, fast consecutive attacks or irregular-timed attacks from bosses were said to have made combat issues even worse and contributed to negative experiences. [/p][p]There were also opinions questioning whether it was appropriate for the bosses encountered at this point in the game to have this level of difficulty. [/p][p] [/p][p]As a development team, we generally agree with these opinions. [/p][p]We have been discussing what kind of action style would be most fitting and enjoyable for the game we are making, and we have concluded that the combat should be adjusted to feel lighter and more dynamic than it did in the alpha test version. [/p][p] [/p][p]We are not simply saying that attack animations should become faster. [/p][p]We plan to improve the responsiveness and fluidity between actions, and we are also reviewing control mechanics that will allow attacks to continue even when interrupted, depending on the character’s mechanics and the situation. [/p][p]Rather than focusing on memorizing enemy attack patterns and moving accordingly, we aim to develop combat in a direction where players can enjoy reacting with quick, intuitive responses. [/p][p]We want to build a combat system that allows players to aim for impactful heavy blows or combos based on their growth and skill, instead of being limited to repetitive short attacks. [/p][p]We will also work to improve the current ambiguity in skill usability and value, and we plan to add rewarding Precision Action mechanics to create more enjoyable combat overall. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]• Third: Hit Impact[/b] [/p][p]The lack of hit impact is something the development team also strongly agrees with. [/p][p]This is something we should have done much better and the fact that we were not fully prepared in this area is not something we can excuse. [/p][p]Rather than making excuses, we believe it is right to simply say that we fell short, and that we will make it better. [/p][p] [/p][p]We have already begun various improvement tasks, including camera effects, visual effects, hit stops, and other technical elements. [/p][p]We are preparing to improve not only the impact players feel when attacking enemies, but also the feedback when taking hits on both sides. [/p][p] [/p][p]As for sound effects, we have just begun making improvements after successfully hiring a sound designer. [/p][p]However, due to the lack of time before the alpha test, we proceeded with the test while the sound was still in an unsatisfactory state. [/p][p]Our sound designer is highly motivated to create much better sound throughout the game, along with a more satisfying hit impact in the next build, and we will work together to prepare an improved version. [/p][p] [/p][p]We are also reviewing many other areas of feedback for improvement. [/p][p]For example, we plan to remove the campsite resting feature, enable automatic recovery, and add options to adjust the intensity of physical effects as you suggested. [/p][p]Additionally, many elements that were temporarily applied because the game is still in development will gradually be refined into their intended final forms. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Reflections on the Alpha Test[/b] [/p][p]There were many twists and turns as we worked to prepare the alpha test build in time for Steam Next Fest. [/p][p]We built what we thought was the final version, only to find new issues, fix them, and build again. Honestly, we lost count of how many times we said, “This is the last one.” [/p][p]At one point, we received an internal report that the game wouldn’t run on a specific graphics card. [/p][p]We urgently tracked one down (even searching popular secondhand marketplaces) to get it on short notice. [/p][p]After finally getting the card and attempting to reproduce the issue, the problem didn’t occur at all, which made troubleshooting even harder. 
We patched what we believed was the most likely cause, uploaded what we thought would finally be the last build, and then began the test. [/p][p]However, the issue wasn’t resolved. We continued tracking the problem and released near-daily patches to gradually improve and fix it. [/p][p]In the end, it turned out to be a common issue in the engine version we’re currently using. We were able to partially resolve it by applying the latest version of the engine code. [/p][p]On top of this, we also encountered login failures, account restrictions, and other issues that weren’t caused by the game itself but by external systems. 
It took quite some time to track these down and resolve them by working with teams across the company. [/p][p]We sincerely apologize to those who experienced these inconveniences. [/p][p]Even so, many of you continued participating in the test and provided invaluable feedback. We are truly grateful for your patience and support. [/p][p][/p][p]As players, you naturally wouldn’t have known which parts of the game were finished and which were still unfinished, and of course, you didn’t need to worry about that when giving your feedback. [/p][p]That said, we, as the development team, feel a great deal of regret about the unfinished elements you saw. [/p][p]For example, the in-game settings menu didn’t yet offer detailed graphics options, which meant you couldn’t fine-tune the settings for smoother performance. [/p][p]The Fitting Room was fully open from the start of the alpha test to allow smooth functionality testing. 
The Fitting Room also included a test shop, and many of the available outfits didn’t match the world’s setting. [/p][p]At this point, we have only a limited selection of finished armor and medieval fantasy-style outfits, but many more are currently in production. 
We plan to significantly increase the share of world-appropriate outfits in future builds. [/p][p]In co-op mode, we are also considering adding an option that allows players to display default outfits for those who prefer not to see designs that don’t match the game’s setting. [/p][p]The gesture list was temporarily assembled for system testing. 
Some of the gestures were for test purposes only, which sometimes resulted in visibly awkward arm movements. [/p][p]Additionally, many other features such as Followers, Kalbram Supply, Ability, and item drops, were configured specifically for this test build. 
We will continue refining these elements to bring them closer to the final version. [/p][p][/p][p]There are simply too many things we regret and are not satisfied with to list them all. [/p][p]Before closing, we’d like to sincerely thank you once again for participating in the test and providing your invaluable feedback. [/p][p]We always believe that we are not yet good enough, and it’s exactly this mindset that motivates us to keep improving. [/p][p]Because we know our own shortcomings, we’ll keep working hard to deliver a better game. [/p][p] [/p][p]From all of us at CAG Studio, Vindictus: Defying Fate Development Team. [/p]

notes.title: End of Alpha Test – Thank You for Participating
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Vindictus: Defying Fate team. 
We would like to express our sincere thanks to all players who participated in the global Alpha Test with enthusiasm over the past eight days. 

The Alpha Test officially ended on June 17, 2025 (Tue) 06:59 (UTC) / June 16, 2025 (Mon) 23:59 (PDT), and the Steam Demo client is no longer accessible. 

We truly appreciate your time and support, even though some parts of the test may have felt rough or incomplete. 
Please rest assured that we are carefully reviewing all the feedback you have shared with us. 

If you were unable to complete the in-game survey, an online version will remain open for two additional days after the test ends. 
Your feedback is a valuable part of Vindictus: Defying Fate’s journey moving forward. 

Once again, thank you for spending your valuable time with Vindictus: Defying Fate and for your support. 
We look forward to sharing more updates with you soon. 

Thank you.

notes.title: Alpha Test – Online Survey Now Available
notes.content:
Alpha Test – Online Survey Now Available 

Hello, this is the Vindictus: Defying Fate team. 
We sincerely thank all players who have continued to log in and play during the Alpha Test. 
To better understand your valuable feedback, we would like to once again share the survey we have prepared. 

- A brief pop-up survey during gameplay 
- A survey accessible via the in-game top menu → [User Survey] 

Among these, the survey available through the [User Survey] menu in the game is now also available online through a dedicated webpage. 
The questions in this online survey are the same as those in the in-game version. If you have already completed the survey, you do not need to participate again. 

This online survey is intended for players who were unable to complete the survey during the test period, or had difficulty doing so in-game. If that applies to you, we would greatly appreciate it if you could share your feedback through the online survey link below. 

[h3]■ In-Game Survey Period [/h3]
[h3]June 9, 2025 (Mon) 02:00 – June 17, 2025 (Tue) 06:59 (UTC) [/h3]
[h3]June 8, 2025 (Sun) 19:00 – June 16, 2025 (Mon) 23:59 (PDT) [/h3]

We kindly ask for your honest and thoughtful feedback. 

Thank you.

notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is the Vindictus: Defying Fate team.[/p][p]We have applied an update to help reduce client crashes that may occur when using certain graphics cards or driver versions.[/p][p]- Performance issues were occurring on PCs equipped with NVIDIA GeForce 4060 or 4070, where the graphics quality preset was automatically set to Maximum on first launch, causing potential frame rate drops.

notes.title: How to Check and Install a Supported Graphics Driver Version
notes.content: [p]Hello, this is the Vindictus: Defying Fate team.[/p][p][/p][p]As mentioned in our previous announcement and FAQ, we’ve identified crash issues related to certain graphics driver versions. Since the start of the Alpha Test, we’ve received a notable number of crash reports related to this issue.[/p][p][/p][p]In particular, crashes have been observed specifically with NVIDIA Graphics Driver version 576. We kindly ask you to download and use version 572 or earlier, as previously advised.[/p][p][/p][p]Please refer to the instructions below to check your current graphics driver version and download a supported version.[/p][p][/p][p][b]1. Check Your NVIDIA Graphics Driver Version[/b][/p][p]1) Open the NVIDIA App from the icon in your Windows taskbar.[/p][p](You can also check the version through NVIDIA Control Panel or GeForce Experience.)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/2565e3e555d403091f687dfe7e57a56ef95cccc5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]2) Check your driver version:[/p][p]- You can find this under System > My Rig in the NVIDIA App.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/5c3104dd7414d2f19d6c9171f4592b358cba313e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Download NVIDIA Graphics Driver Version 572 or Earlier[/b][/p][p]If you are currently using NVIDIA Graphics Driver version 576, the game may crash during launch. A driver version lower than 576 is required.[/p][p]We recommend installing version 572 or earlier by following the steps below.[/p][p][/p][p]1) Uninstall the current driver (version 576.XX) from your PC.[/p][p][/p][p]2) Visit the official NVIDIA website and enter your graphics card details to search for available drivers. \[Go to NVIDIA Driver Search]([url="https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/drivers/"]https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/drivers/[/url])[/p][p][/p][p]3) Download driver version lower than 572[/p][p]We recommend that you download 572.XX versions such as below from the results.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/254b29332cda88172f03e5a740a6765e8f4dd7c6.png"][/img][/p][p]If you encounter any further bugs or technical problems, please report them through the #｜game-feedback channel on our official Discord server.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Photo Mode Guide
notes.content:
[p][b]■ Photo Mode Overview[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/8ee2287d8feb8a3ebf10fd644f83bc1f471f0f90.jpg"][/img]Photo Mode is a dedicated screenshot feature that lets you freely capture your desired moments in real time by adjusting both the camera angle and character movements in-game.

[b]■ Entry Conditions and How to Access[/b]
[b]1) Entry Conditions[/b]
- Photo Mode cannot be activated during combat with monsters.
- If you're locked on while out of combat, lock-on will be automatically released before entering.
- Entry is not allowed during interactions, cutscenes, or forced story sequences.

[b]2) How to Access[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/23ef23deaf87501e68098f97f7d58395ed86e06a.jpg"][/img][b][Keyboard & Mouse: V / Controller: D-Pad Down][/b]
- Go to: Menu > Camera > Photo Mode
[i]※ Photo Mode will automatically close if you take damage.[/i]

[b]■ Basic Functions[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/6d60a0f486fa4f704b9650c8cb6dc449fc8e439e.jpg"][/img][b]1) Camera Controls[/b]
You can rotate, move (vertically and horizontally), and zoom the camera around the character.
To prevent collision with terrain or objects, the camera avoids obstacles and makes the character semi-transparent at close range.

[b]2) Switching Control Target[/b]
You can toggle between controlling the character and controlling the camera.

[b]3) Hiding HUD and UI[/b]
Press [b][Keyboard & Mouse: Q / Controller: Y][/b] to toggle the HUD and UI on or off.

[b]4) Taking Screenshots[/b]
Screenshots are saved as PNG files in your current resolution. The UI is not included in the saved image.

[b]5) Gallery Upload[/b]
Captured screenshots can be uploaded to the platform gallery.

*All system names are temporary and subject to change.
[/p]

notes.title: Customization & Gesture Guide
notes.content:
[b]■ Customization Overview[/b]
Freely express your character’s individuality and style through a wide range of customization options, divided into appearance and physique categories.
[b]- Appearance:[/b] Customize weapons, outfits, hair, eye color (iris), makeup, mole, scars, and more.
[b]- Physique:[/b] Adjust height, muscle, head size, neck size, chest size, waist size, breast size, hip width, arm thickness, thigh thickness, calf thickness, skin tone, and shine level.

[b]■ Customization by Category[/b]

[b]1) Outfit[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/366a84cada731bb1481b0c00644f10abb502c427.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/8c220b6bd9aa9c501b9cdb910a28bee32246ec21.jpg[/img]
Mix and match outfit or apply dye to create a unique look and style.
- Head
- Top (including Dress)
- Bottom
- Gloves
- Footwear
- Outfit Sets

[b]2) Style[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/ba667859c3eb25133bfb23523dfd572fe3021d0f.jpg[/img]
Fine-tune your character’s appearance in detail.
- Hair (including eyebrow color)
- Makeup (eyes, cheeks, lips)
- Iris
- Facial Hair (male only)
- Face (beauty marks, scars, tan lines, etc.)
- Body Skin (beauty marks, scars, tanning, etc.)

[b]3) Physique[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/584acf0a61b07019d35cfb981fd368196cece89e.jpg[/img]
Adjust body proportions and skin properties to achieve your desired silhouette.
- Body Adjustments (height, head size, muscle, waist size, etc.)
- Skin tone, shine

[b]4) Weapons[/b]
You can dye your Main Weapon and Secondary Weapon.

[b]■ Dye Preset Information[/b]
- When you purchase any appearance item that can be dyed, one free dye preset is provided.
- Once registered, the dye preset will not be deleted and will remain even if you discard the item.
※ Please note that this may be subject to change. Prior notice will be given if a retrieval policy is applied in the future.
- You can save and load dye history as presets, making it easy to maintain or switch your personal style.

[b]■ Gesture System[/b]
[b]1) Gesture Menu[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/4b8d3c2f02965afda9feff7262f702d167eb5d70.jpg[/img]
Displays the list of gestures you own.
You can register gestures in the presets for easy access during combat or exploration.

[b]2) Preset Editing[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/dc4e80583a8a3ef4dbe886eb5b79e83c6a458609.jpg[/img]
Gestures can be accessed by opening the preset via shortcut key and selecting the desired action.
This is especially useful in Photo Mode, multiplayer, or community activities.

[b]3) Gestures Types[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/65dccecd00da368c9609d7be729d5323f1080a26.jpg[/img]
[b]Exclusive Gestures:[/b]
Provided by default when a character is created. Each character features unique animations that reflect their personality and charm.
[b]Shared Gestures:[/b]
Gestures with shared animations based on gender. These include motions useful for communication during multiplayer.

*All system names are temporary and subject to change.

notes.title: Growth System Guide
notes.content:
[b]■ Ability System[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/1b56336b4c0a798a38814b6dbcca5143b8986de6.jpg[/img]
The Ability System is a dedicated growth system which includes 'Shared Abilities' that apply account-wide and 'Exclusive Abilities' that enhance the unique skills of each character.
Abilities are unlocked through a skill tree and progress sequentially along the chosen path.
[i][b]※ Abilities cannot be reset. Once unlocked, their effects are permanent.[/b][/i]

[b]1) Ability Types[/b]
- Shared Abilities: Applied to all characters.
[i]e.g., Increased Flask capacity, stat boosts, etc.[/i]
- Exclusive Abilities: Enhance specific skills for individual characters.
[i]e.g., Unlocking character exclusive skills.[/i]

[b]2) Types of Resources[/b]
[table][tr][th]Resource[/th][th]Purpose[/th][/tr]
[tr][td]Ability Points[/td][td]Used to unlock all abilities[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Still Crystal of Eternity[/td][td]Required for key Shared Abilities[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Frozen Orb of Origins[/td][td]Used to unlock the ultimate ability of Shared Abilities[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Burning Crystal of Eternity[/td][td]Required for key Exclusive Abilities[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Tempestuous Orb of Origins[/td][td]Used to unlock the ultimate ability of Exclusive Abilities[/td][/tr][/table]
[i]※ Aside from Ability Points, the other materials are separated into Shared and Exclusive ability upgrade resources.[/i]

[b]■ Account Level System[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/6b9b0bfadffe0fe6b4e9b0c850ba92770aa22a40.jpg[/img]
The Account Level system applies growth universally across all characters.
Level progression is tied to the account instead of individual characters, and is earned through story progression and combat.
Upon leveling up, stat bonuses are granted and shared across all characters in your account.
Since the system is account-based, switching characters will still maintain the bonuses from your current level.

[b]■ Craft & Enhance Weapon System[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/e7c1e408faf6f347c1f28f29dac53f2f6678ea9a.jpg[/img]
Through the Craft & Enhance Weapon system, you can craft unique, character exclusive weapon appearances.
Crafted weapons can be enhanced to increase their Weapon Level, which boosts character stats accordingly.
The crafting and enhancement process consists of the following steps:

[b]1) Unlocking Crafting[/b]
You can acquire blueprint designs by defeating boss monsters or completing Special Missions.
Once obtained, you’ll be able to craft the corresponding weapon appearance.
[i]※ Crafting unlocks apply account-wide, and once obtained, all characters will have access to the blueprint.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/f65487033849f46c80575d9b73200403aae7a92e.jpg[/img]

[b]2) Weapon Crafting[/b]
Unlocked weapons can be crafted exclusively for each character, once you meet the material and cost requirements.
Crafting may also grant a Secondary Weapon alongside the Main Weapon.
[i]※ Crafted weapons can be viewed and changed in the Appearance tab of the Fitting Room.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/02ee7d483346c5074dce5e08b13e40a547df539d.jpg[/img]

[b]3) Weapon Enhancement[/b]
Each enhancement raises the Weapon Level.
"Enhancing weapons increases their Weapon Level, enhancing character stats such as Attack, Critical Chance, and Precision.	"
Enhancement consumes materials and Hanner, and each weapon has a set enhancement limit.
[i]※ The Craft & Enhance Weapon system is subject to change upon launch, and players will be notified accordingly.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/066d99da80882d9ccb0fd6fd4a802675389c07ca.jpg[/img]

[b]■ Kalbram Supplies[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/24b4989fe8576249a79af1b8741add489fb99a67.jpg[/img]
Earn the trust of the Kalbram Mercenaries by completing missions and claim a variety of rewards.
You can increase your Supply Level by completing objectives throughout each region.

[b]1) Rewards[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/9707a18ce0ab2e17dff09f70f5c79ce495b404e2.jpg[/img]
When a certain amount of "Kalbram Supplies Credits” is accumulated through mission completion, your Supply Level increases, and you’ll earn the rewards associated with each level.
Rewards range from essential resources like Hanner, to items required for Abilities and Weapon Crafting, as well as exclusive outfits that are only available through Kalbram Supplies.

[b]2) Missions[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/ead6d0493144ee7f3d8ec5746470bdc88fc7d6a0.jpg[/img]
Missions are categorized into Daily Missions and Challenge Missions.
Daily Missions: Defeat designated monsters each day.
[i]※ Reset time: 00:00 UTC / 09:00 KST[/i]
Challenge Missions: Available once per Kalbram Supplies event period and include objectives beyond combat.

[b]■ Item Chests[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/e008e69ae99988f3b0ea72d450496ffebacf3da2.gif[/img]
Item chests are scattered throughout the combat zones.
When players approach a chest, an interaction button will appear. You can obtain rewards by interacting with them.
Besides small and large chests, you can also find other lootable items, like glowing drops scattered on the ground.

*All system names are temporary and subject to change.

notes.title: Item & Inventory Guide
notes.content:
[b]■ Item Types[/b]
[b]1) Cosmetic Items[/b]
Cosmetic items are used solely to customize your character’s appearance and do not affect character stats.
They are categorized into Weapons, Outfits, and Beauty (Hair, Makeup, etc).
Weapon appearances can be obtained through the weapon crafting system. This process increases the Weapon Crafting Level, which affects character stats.
Cosmetic items can be shared across all characters of the same gender.

[b]2) Flovian Flask[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/07933378b8e057fa82a73618f236f299e1d7f3a5.jpg[/img]
The Flovian Flask is a default recovery item provided to all players.
It can be used during combat and is automatically refilled when resting at a campsite.
Its performance can be enhanced through certain Abilities.

[b]3) Consumable Recovery Items[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/67d774672968fcf85d9ecf52e2f36a88eb8f23e4.jpg[/img]
These items provide immediate effects upon use and can be used during combat.
While similar in function to the Flovian Flask, they are limited to the quantity held in your inventory.
Consumables can be obtained from monster drops or found in chests within combat zones.

[b]■ Inventory, Storage, and Quickslots[/b]

[b]1) Inventory UI[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/5786265e0c07fe12df33138f50c7fa9e2b2087f7.jpg[/img]
The inventory allows you to manage the items you have acquired.
- View item details
- Discard items
- Assign or remove items to/from the quickslot
[i]※ Note: During the Alpha Test, items cannot be used directly from the inventory. They must be registered in the quickslot for use.[/i]

[b]2) Storage UI[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/8163a8ed2700c7d7976170794d884c9be03c037a.jpg[/img]
Some combat items have a maximum carry limit for inventory and quickslots. When the limit is exceeded, excess items are automatically stored.
If you rest at a campsite, any eligible items in storage will be automatically restocked into your inventory and quickslots.

[b]3) Quickslot[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/c27e03cc9d98c4743e1e4e9eaf2e10a1b2a86833.jpg[/img]
The quickslot allows players to use items quickly during combat.
- From the inventory, press [Keyboard & Mouse: R / Controller: X] to assign items to a quickslot.
- Registered items are consumed one at a time when used.
- If an item's count reaches zero, the slot becomes inactive.
- Items can be replenished by resting at a campsite or looting during combat.

*All system names are temporary and subject to change.

notes.title: JUNE DEV LOG
notes.content:
Greetings, Players.
This is our June Dev Log, shared ahead of the upcoming Alpha Test.

As the Alpha Test draws near, our team is putting the final touches on the build.
Today, we’d like to walk you through some of the features you’ll be able to experience during the Alpha Test.


[b]1. Fitting Room: Customize Your Character[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/676720d36bfe1ba9012660fbfa8e1d0ecbe86bd6.png[/img]
In this Alpha Test, you’ll be able to enter the ‘Fitting Room’ to personalize your character’s appearance in a variety of ways.
Choose your preferred Physique and combine items from the Style Shop such as Outfits, Hair, Iris, Scars, and Moles to create a look that reflects your unique personality. And of course, Outfits can be dyed using Dye Ampoules.

To help you enjoy the fun of customization, this Alpha Test includes a variety of elements such as outfits and hair. You can easily pick up all of these items as you play. So after a battle, take a moment to drop by the Fitting Room and customize your character to your liking.


[b]2. Story: Member of the Kalbram Mercenaries[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/f7c157327a324c9ea0e1756031bf96a7c5de2e16.png[/img]
In the Alpha Test, you’ll uncover a series of events taking place in and around Colhen Village, the base of the ‘Kalbram Mercenaries’. As a member of the Kalbram Mercenaries, you’ll investigate the ‘Northern Ruins’, which are now occupied by ‘Gnolls’, under the command of ‘Gwynn’ from the Royal Knights. You'll also be deployed to ‘Hoarfrost Hollow’ on a separate mission, where you'll face an inevitable showdown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/f2bd0814071730fdf4452c7bf5e666d536466f99.png[/img]
Although the Alpha Test does not reveal a large portion of the story, we encourage you to listen closely to the voices of the Kalbram Mercenaries who guard the village and the people of Colhen. It will help you enjoy the test on a deeper level.

Subtitles will be available in Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. Key story cutscenes will also be voiced in Korean and English, with language options adjustable in the settings menu. We plan to support more languages in the official release.


[b]3. 4-Player Multiplayer: Face Even Stronger Boss Monsters[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/d4ad94c92d52e80e1737c12bb99f8746e6cf5bfb.png[/img]
We’ve prepared multiplayer content where up to four players can take on powerful boss monsters together. Two formidable bosses await, promising intense and exhilarating battles. Multiplayer content becomes available after completing the main story. As for the bosses, we encourage you to discover them for yourself when the test begins. (Though some of you may have already spotted them in previously released footage!)

Please note that during this test, multiplayer parties will be formed through auto-matchmaking only, and selecting party members manually will not be available. We appreciate your understanding. If you prefer to fight alone, you can also take on the boss monster solo.

That’s all for the June Dev Log. Be sure to check out our Steam, X, Discord, and our official website for more guides and announcements as the test approaches.

We look forward to seeing you in the Alpha Test.

Sincerely,
Vindictus: Defying Fate Dev Team

notes.title: A Letter from the Development Team
notes.content:
Greetings from the Vindictus: Defying Fate development team. 


[b]🛠 Ahead of the Test [/b]
To begin with, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to everyone who has shown interest in the Alpha Test. 

The Pre-Alpha Test conducted in March 2024 primarily focused on verifying the enjoyment and design direction of the combat system. 
We initially expected participation from a relatively small group of players experienced with hardcore action games and therefore set the difficulty level relatively high. 
However, far more players joined the test than we had anticipated, and we recognize that some players, especially those less familiar with action games, found the difficulty level to be too challenging. 
We’d like to apologize for any frustration this may have caused and deeply appreciate everyone who shared their valuable feedback. 

The Alpha Test for Vindictus: Defying Fate is scheduled to take place during the upcoming June Steam Next Fest, and we warmly invite you to join us. 

Ahead of the test, we’d like to share a few important details with you. 


[b]🎮 Difficulty Adjustment [/b]
After about 15 months of development, the difficulty of this Alpha Test has been adjusted to reflect the level originally intended by the development team. 
Vindictus: Defying Fate is designed to be an action game that is approachable for everyone, while rewarding skill with faster clears and more stylish gameplay. 
The two available difficulty levels—Easy and Normal—can be switched at any time, allowing players to adjust the experience to their preference. 
We hope this change makes the game more enjoyable and accessible to a broader range of players. 


[b]🧭 Newly Added Content [/b]
New story elements and combat areas have been added for this Alpha Test. 
[list][*] In the first area, [b]Northern Ruins[/b], players will experience story progression along with relevant battles. 
[*]Following that, players can move on to [b]Hoarfrost Hollow[/b], which focuses more on combat-oriented gameplay. [/list]Both areas have undergone major changes since the Pre-Alpha Test. We’ve added elements such as interactive objects and traps, as requested by many of you. 
Additionally, a new [b]Follower System[/b] has been added, allowing players to fight alongside Followers or switch to other characters after a certain point in the game. 

While the core gameplay experience is based on single-player, once the Northern Ruins storyline is completed, players will be able to encounter others in town. 


[b]🧍 New Playable Characters [/b]
In the Pre-Alpha Test, only [b]Lann [/b]and [b]Fiona [/b]were available. In this Alpha Test, [b]Delia [/b]and [b]Karok [/b]have been added, making a total of four playable characters. 
Each character has unique abilities and playstyles, so we encourage you to try them all. 


[b]⚔️ New Battle Mode: Special Missions [/b]
In this Alpha Test, a new battle mode called ‘[b]Special Missions[/b]’ becomes available [b]once you've completed the Northern Ruins storyline. 
[/b][list][*] You can participate in this content through either single-player or multiplayer, depending on your preference. 
[*] Unlike the content mentioned earlier, this mode is designed to deliver a challenging combat experience. 
[*] As content separate from the main story, it offers a great opportunity to players who enjoy high-difficulty battles to test their skills and find enjoyment in overcoming tough encounters. [/list]During the Alpha Test, multiplayer parties for Special Missions will only be formed through auto-matchmaking. Manual party selection will not be available. We kindly ask for your understanding. 

[b]🔧 About the Nature of the Alpha Test [/b]
As this is an Alpha Test, many aspects of the game [b]are still under development.[/b] Please keep the following notes in mind during your test experience. 
[list][*] The Kalbram Supplies system, which you’ll soon experience, was added to supplement areas of the game that are currently incomplete for this test. Its inclusion in the final version has not yet been decided. 
[*] The [b]Outfit and customization[/b] features have received extra development focus for this test. However, the related items, systems, and acquisition methods are temporarily configured and are likely to change significantly in the final release. With the addition of body shape customization, some physics effects (such as body proportions or clothing material behavior) are still under development. You may find that some elements to feel incomplete or unnatural at this stage. 
[*] The [b]Equipment [/b]system has not yet been implemented. Character progression during this test has been temporarily structured without it. 
[*] The [b]Weapon Crafting & Enhancement[/b] system is also still in development and may feel somewhat unintuitive in its current state. 

[list][*] Weapons themselves do not have inherent stats, but once crafted, their appearance can be freely used. The intended design is for character stats to increase by collecting a variety of weapons. 
[*] However, the current setup may give the impression that each weapon has its own stats and needs to be upgraded individually—this is not the intended design. 
[*] In fact, weapons do not have individual stats. Any stat bonuses gained from enhancing weapons are permanently applied to the character. 
[*] After this Alpha Test, we plan to refine the system to make it clearer and more intuitive. [/list][/list]
[b]🤝 In Closing [/b]
We sincerely thank everyone who has shown interest in and patiently awaited this Alpha Test. 
The feedback you share is incredibly valuable to us. It helps shape the future of the game and drives meaningful improvements. 

We sincerely hope this Alpha Test proves to be both enjoyable and meaningful, and we look forward to having you with us on the journey of Vindictus: Defying Fate. 

Sincerely, 
The Vindictus: Defying Fate Development Team

notes.title: Multiplayer Guide
notes.content:
[h3][b]Village Player Display & Interaction Guide (Multiplayer)[/b]
[/h3]
[b]■ Player Visibility Settings[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/fc234d8a846ec1536ff00dbf5a1f152effe71b48.jpg[/img]In the village, players can see other players’ characters in real time after completing Chapter 1, Episode 1.

[b]How to Enable:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/1b826739f784260496bc4eadce522844175b5bf6.jpg[/img]Setting Location: [Settings] → [Account] tab → [Account Information] → Turn On [Display Players in Villiage] to make other players visible in the village.
Display Elements: Character appearance (including outfits, dyes, and weapons)
[i]※ The multiplayer feature becomes available as you progress through the story.[/i]

[b]■ Player Interaction[/b]
If the "Display Players in Village" option is disabled, other players will not be visible in the village, and no interactions will occur.
If the "Display Players in Village" option is enabled, interactions are only enabled between players who have the feature activated.
[b]- Interaction Examples:[/b]
When another player passes by your character, visual effects such as fluttering clothing may be triggered.
Characters do not block each other and can pass through freely.

[h3][b]Special Missions Rules Guide (Multiplayer)[/b]
[/h3]
[b]■ Special Missions - Basic Rules[/b]
[table]      [tr]      [th]Category[/th]      [th]Details[/th]    [/tr]        [tr][td]Party Size[/td][td]Fixed 4-player party (based on the alpha test)[/td]    [/tr]    [tr][td]Difficulty[/td][td]Fixed: Normal (Difficulty cannot be selected in multiplayer)[/td]    [/tr]    [tr][td]Potion Usage[/td][td]Allowed (Limited to default provision only)[/td]    [/tr]    [tr][td]Revives[/td][td]Up to 2 times per player (Potions are not replenished upon revival)[/td]    [/tr]    [tr][td]Rewards[/td][td]Same rewards as in single-player mode[/td]    [/tr]    [tr][td]Fatal Actions[/td][td]Not available[/td]    [/tr]    [tr][td]Stagger Gauge[/td][td]Disabled (Not displayed during multiplayer)[/td]    [/tr] 
 [tr][td]Time Limit[/td][td]Each Special Mission has a 30-minute time limit per battle.[/td][/tr] [/table][i]※ Special Missions have a fixed 30-minute time limit, whether entered in Single-Player or 4-Player mode.[/i]

[b]■ Entry Rules[/b]
- You can only enter Special Missions when all 4 players in the party are matched.
[i]※ If you enter alone, it will be treated as a single-player battle and will not use a separate server.[/i]
- Even if some players leave during battle, the mission will not end as long as at least one player remains.
- No additional players can join once the battle begins.
- If a player leaves during battle, they will be returned to the village and cannot rejoin.
[i]※ Repeated mid-battle departures may result in penalties.[/i]
[i]※ Monster stats are fixed based on whether the mission is entered in Single-Player or 4-Player mode.[/i]


[b]■ Revival System[/b]
[table]      [tr]      [th]Category[/th]      [th]Details[/th]    [/tr]        [tr][td]Basic Revival[/td][td]Up to 2 revives per player, restores 100% HP[/td]    [/tr]    [tr][td]Auto Revival[/td][td]Automatic revival after a short duration when incapacitated.[/td]    [/tr]    [tr][td]Player Revival[/td][td]Party members can interact to revive incapacitated ally for faster revival.[/td]    [/tr]    [tr][td]Potion Refill[/td][td]Potions are not restored upon revival. [/td]    [/tr]  [/table]

[b]■ Special Missions Completion & Failure[/b]
[b]1) Special Missions Success[/b]
The mission is completed upon defeating the boss monster designated as the target.
The party disbands automatically after the battle and returns to the village.

[b]2) Special Missions Failure[/b]
- The Special Mission fails if all party members run out of revives.
[i]※ Even if revives remain, the mission will be considered a failure if all surviving members are incapacitated at the same time.[/i]

[b]■ Observation Mode[/b]
When a player uses up all available revives, they enter observation mode.
In observation mode, players can watch the battle from the perspective of surviving party members.
[i]※ If you exit the game while in observation mode, you will be considered to have left the party and will forfeit any rewards[/i]

*All system names are temporary and subject to change.

notes.title: Basic System Guide
notes.content:
[b]■ Single Player & Difficulty Settings[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/4a2795870263253855f731542a63f87e8178926b.jpg[/img]You can choose the difficulty level when you first start the game, and change it at any time via [Menu > Settings].
Difficulty settings are only available in single-player mode. Multiplayer mode is locked to Normal difficulty.

[b]■ Map System[/b]
Players can check their current position and nearby terrain using the map.
'Activated Campsites' that have been explored can be used for 'Fast Travel', allowing immediate relocation from the map.
The following elements are displayed on the map:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/8f09a3e87a4a33beae66713ce7afd4bcede2afa6.jpg[/img]- Current Location
- Area Entrances
- Campsite Locations
- Key Locations (e.g., Mercenary Outpost, Inn, Temple)
- Story Progress Indicators
- 'Trial Recall' Locations & Remaining Time

notes.title: Follower System Guide
notes.content:
[b]■ Follower Overview[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/50d8a190902d41ec4818b83ca81826272532e3d6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/042941c0244ff0c95ebf4cbb88250f11374f51dc.jpg[/img]

All characters can be designated as followers. Assigned followers participate in battle as AI-controlled allies that support the player.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/b93bd97beeaa1777361406c1555e7f92491427b8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/3e87c2f7daf3efff76a06bd2f38668b106166e54.jpg[/img]

[b]■ Follower Features[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/a87728516f664927f58f51c904926559807f39ac.gif[/img]
Combat Support Role: Followers support the player in battle by attacking or guarding against enemies based on AI behavior.

[b]■ Follower Behavior During Combat[/b]
Default Positioning: Followers generally stay close to the player and automatically approach enemies to engage in combat when a battle begins.
Attack Pattern: Followers perform combo-based attacks and will dodge or guard depending on the situation.
Damage Response: Followers lose HP when hit by enemy attacks and visibly react to damage with appropriate animations.
※ Some animations and behaviors may appear awkward during the alpha test.

[b]■ Revival System[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/221bbf2aa4fe126b4f8803b52dece84e582472dd.jpg[/img]
When a follower is incapacitated during battle, they will enter a revival standby state. After a set period, they will automatically revive.
You can interact with them to revive them faster.

[b]■ Follower Growth[/b]
Followers grow in the same way as the player. If a follower is later switched to a playable character, their growth progress will be retained.

[b]Growth Elements:[/b]
- Base Stats
- Craft & Enhance Weapons
- Shared / Unique Abilities
- Level System (Shared Across Account)
[i]※ Weapon enhancement levels persist when switching between follower and playable character.[/i]
[i]※ All growth elements are applied to followers, but their final damage is adjusted when applied in combat.[/i]

[b]■ Appearance Customization[/b]
Followers share appearance items with the player.
They use a unified appearance inventory, and any customized look will remain intact when the character is assigned as a follower.

[b]■ Environmental Interaction[/b]
Followers can interact with certain environmental elements.
Can Interact With: Ladders, mantling, ziplines, etc.
Cannot Interact With: Doors, movable objects, falling traps, etc.

*All system names are temporary and subject to change.

notes.title: World Overview & Key Regions
notes.content:
[b][h3]■ Game Overview[/h3][/b]
Vindictus: Defying Fate is an action RPG developed using Unreal Engine 5, based on the IP of Vindictus.

Set in a fantasy world inspired by Celtic mythology, the game tells the stories of various characters who defy their fate. With a reimagined narrative rooted in the original IP, it offers diverse combat tempos and action styles across each playable character.

You can enjoy unique combat experiences of each character, and can change them according to the situation to tackle the same enemies in various ways.

Character customization is one of the core elements of this game, allowing free appearance settings through body types (excluding the face), outfit combinations consisting of up to 5 parts, custom dyeing for each part of the outfit.
　
[b][h3]■ World Setting
[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/51b7d32672eccd74bb5305f792088206d86d29b2.png[/img]
The world is gripped by a long-standing war between two races, humans and the Fomors.
Each believes that only by annihilating the other can they fulfill the prophecy and reach the promised paradise, “Erinn.”

You, the player, are a member of the human faction’s Kalbram Mercenaries, taking part in the escalating conflict against the Fomors. However, this war is not simply about race. Greed, fractured beliefs, and clashes of differing values will test your resolve.

Your journey won’t always be guided by clear notions of good and evil, but every choice you make will change the course of your fate.
　
[b][h3]■ Key Regions

[/h3][/b][b]1) Northern Ruins[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/a79c3fc31d6529daaae159245ddd0999ce2954c0.png[/img]
Ancient ruins now overtaken by nature. Once a sacred ground, the area is currently occupied by the “Gnolls,” one of the Fomor sub-factions.

This is the first major battlefield in the Alpha Test and acts as both a tutorial and the game's opening region. The deeper you venture, the more you’ll see a unique blend of weathered architecture and newly constructed structures from recent settlers.

Having once lived as nomads, the Gnolls now appear to be establishing a permanent settlement in the Northern Ruins, an act that’s rapidly intensifying tensions in the region.
　
[b]2) Frozen Valley[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/0f1548df943eca8bdca02e24ed0f7cbc5999dd14.png[/img]
A crystalline landscape formed by an ancient ice volcano.

A mix of winding valleys and cavernous interiors, this region alternates between indoor and outdoor environments.

Its glacial terrain and subdued lighting creates a chilling tension, with traces of resource mining scattered throughout. Some areas are connected to the surface, offering open visibility while also revealing that this land was designed for industrial use, much like a mining facility.

The Kobold Tribe, known for their resilience and labor, resides in the area, where tensions over resources may arise.
　
[b]3) Colhen Village[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/b1a95b62ae248952de27bb6b280f7d82feb0420e.png[/img]

Colhen is the game’s central hub and home to multiple systems and narrative progression.
Though it once suffered major destruction from a Fomor invasion, it was rebuilt by its villagers and is now also used as a base by the Kalbram Mercenaries.

The village represents a world where war and peace coexist, serving as a hub for various content and systems, including key NPC interactions, the Fitting Room, and customization features.

Certain features, such as weapon crafting for character progression and community-based features, are exclusively available in the village. After completing the main story, players can connect with others in real time, enabling rich multiplayer interactions.

notes.title: APRIL DEV LOG
notes.content:
Greetings, Players! It's been a while since our last Dev Log.
We hope you've all been doing well.
Today we've brought some new updates on our development progress, following the pre-alpha test, and briefly introduce the new characters, Delia and Karok, revealed from our last trailer video.

[h3]1. New Field Elements[/h3]
You may remember defeating enemies and squeezing through narrow paths to reach the boss back in the pre-alpha.
In the upcoming Alpha test, you’ll encounter even more interactive elements throughout the battlefield:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/ea52aab8cce6c8c3d25d743425cd46f78c1d1630.gif[/img]
You'll be able to climb ladders and ride ziplines to venture places out of reach,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/ea861021996766a98423127aa5254a40512742c0.gif[/img]
and use grappling hooks to overcome obstacles in your way.

Of course, this won't be the only thing you'll come across, as there will be various challenges during your adventure.
You'll have to battle through enemies waiting for you to arrive, or might stumble on a trap to distract you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/e008e69ae99988f3b0ea72d450496ffebacf3da2.gif[/img]
But don't worry, you'll also be able to discover hidden rewards throughout your exploration, so we recommend opening any chests you find on your way.

[h3]2. Enhanced Combat Experience[/h3]
[b]1) Precision Action[/b]
During your journey, meeting a formidable enemy is inevitable.
For situations like this where you can't avoid engaging in battle, we've designed a special combat experience called 'Precision Action'. We expect this to bring satisfaction from mastering combat and overcoming even the toughest foes.
Note that in Vindictus: Defying Fate, a Precision Action refers to an action executed in sync with an enemy’s attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/503ede3b5b41a471cb29bad9ab6ba2ddba9e5897.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/a12c6512a195a15b4b78fefe9448751b4ee200ff.gif[/img]
The key to Precision Action is executing the action with precise timing.
When successful, it either triggers a Perfect Guard, blocking the attack entirely, or a Perfect Dodge, which flows into a powerful counterattack, depending on the character.
Master the enemy's movements and turn the tide of battle with Precision Action!

[b]2) Monster's Stagger State and Fatal Action[/b]
When an enemy is staggered and can no longer maintain its stance, a stylish Fatal Action is a great option to gain the upper hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/6839107740d1e450d8b8a32f1047e1ba65152c5e.gif[/img]
By attacking the enemy you can build up a stagger gauge, and when the gauge is full the enemy loses its stance for a brief moment.
You can then perform the Fatal Action to the unconscious enemy, taking it down.

To maximize the thrill of combat, all characters: Lann, Fiona, Karok, and Delia, will receive a unique Fatal Action fit for their own distinct combat styles.

[h3]3. Karok and Delia[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/ef5137f2d9fc624184a8c51fdae6dce682652026.png[/img]
"Karok" is a half-giant warrior who crushes his opponents with a massive pillar.
(In the world of Vindictus: Defying Fate, Half-Giant refers to those born between human and giant bloodlines.)
He may seem grave, but he's a man of a warm heart, dedicated to protecting the weak.
Don't miss out on his powerful presence during battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/4e3161988f81e1fabf3940e740c2450548f3be93.png[/img]
"Delia" is a noble princess with confidence in her own path, who cleaves through opponents with a mighty greatsword.
With an unwavering sense of justice and proud elegance, she earns the trust of everyone she meets.
We hope you look forward to seeing what she can do on the battlefield.

Thank you once again for your continued interest and support.
More updates will be revealed going forward, so please stay tuned with us on our official X and Discord.

We'll be back with more updates in the next Dev Log.

Thank you.
Vindictus: Defying Fate Dev Team

[quote]A: Adding the game to your wishlist ensures that you’ll be among the first to receive updates on future tests and the official launch.

[h3]Q: Can I customize the appearance of my equipment or weapons?[/h3]
[quote]A: Yes, you can change or dye your equipment and outfits, and even customize individual outfit pieces to create a look that suits your style.[/quote]

[quote]A: In the Alpha Test, you’ll be able to play as four different characters. The number of characters available at launch or in future updates has not yet been finalized.

[h3]Q: Can I play with other players during the Alpha Test?[/h3]
[quote]A: Yes, multiplayer is available in certain content within the Alpha Test. You’ll also be able to interact with other players in the village area.[/quote]

[quote]A: Console version is currently under development, but the release timeline and supported platforms have not yet been determined.[/quote]

[quote]A: Vindictus: Defying Fate is an action RPG that offers fast-paced, responsive combat through a variety of playable characters, with a combat style that sets it apart from Souls-like games.

notes.title: August Dev Log
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Mercenaries,   [/h3]

As we move from July into August, the intense summer heat continues. 

Today, we're here to cool off the summer heat with a refreshing look at the 'Frozen Valley', 

and the 'Kobold' tribe you can encounter there. 


[b][h3]1. Introducing the Frozen Valley[/h3][/b]
Beyond the Northern Ruins lies a land covered in ice—the 'Frozen Valley'. 

Though not far from the Northern Ruins, this area features an environment completely different from what you're used to. 

The chill from a distant ice volcano has dramatically shaped the climate here. 
 
[b][Frozen Valley][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/0556f49d39f3fdc086201662bd7284a81cf81655.jpg[/img]
[i]Please note that the visuals are subject to change. [/i]


[b][h3]2. Features of the Frozen Valley [/h3][/b]
The Frozen Valley is within Fomor territory, but the Fomor forces have not established a military base or settlement here. 

This is due to the unstable ice volcano and the pervasive cold that envelops the area. 

This is also why human forces have not expanded into this area, despite Fomor’s loose surveillance. 

Amidst this snow-covered wilderness, free from the influence of both factions, only the unique 'Brig' crystals shine and glimmer in the cold light. 
  

[b][h3]3. The Kobold Tribe[/h3][/b]
In the Frozen Valley, you'll encounter the 'Kobold Tribe', who make their livelihood through physical labor. 

[b][Kobold at Work][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/8f7d5b5a4df0edf97f79fa5b710bf52ad155cc18.jpg[/img]
[i]Please note that the visuals are subject to change. [/i]


The Kobold Tribe takes great pride in their robust physiques, powerful strength, and swift work skills, which allow them to handle even the toughest labor with ease. 

Their favorite activity is gathering with fellow tribe members to enjoy a spicy garlic meal after completing their tasks perfectly. 
 

What brought the Kobold Tribe to this cold and dangerous Frozen Valley? 


Many untold stories remain in Vindictus: Defying Fate. 

The monthly Dev Log series will take a brief hiatus after August. We'll be back soon with even more exciting content and good news. 

In the meantime, stay cool, and we look forward to seeing you in the next Dev Log. 
 
Thank you. 


[i][b]<Vindictus: Defying Fate> Dev Team  [/b][/i]

notes.title: July Dev Log
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Mercenaries,   [/h3]

In the previous Dev Log, we introduced you to Colhen and Kalbram merc. 


Today, let's explore the 'Northern Ruins,' the first battle area you'll venture into, and the 'Gnoll' tribe of Fomors you'll encounter there. 


[b][h3]1. Introduction to the Northern Ruins [/h3][/b]
A border region next to Colhen. Here, ruins worn down by time are scattered and mingled with nature. 

Humans refer to this place, whose original purpose has long been forgotten, as the 'Northern Ruins' in the land of the northern Fomors. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/c3cd51927649afa19bd65333c3616c7eb3689208.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/e197f7c1787c5bb9fa37c839fa70958f58ce5126.jpg[/img]

The Northern Ruins are near the front line that separates human and Fomor territories.  

It was once human land, but due to the strength of the Unified Fomor Forces, the front line was pushed back, and absorbed as Fomor territory. 


Despite being occupied by the Fomor forces, the Northern Ruins remained abandoned. 

Due to its proximity to each other's territories, neither side was willing to advance recklessly, resulting in its status as a neutral zone by mutual, unspoken agreement. 


[b][h3]2. The Current State of the Northern Ruins and the Gnoll Tribe [/h3][/b]
As the war between humans and Fomors dragged on, the Royal Knights and the Fomor Force held back their attacks, focusing on reorganizing their battle lines. 

However, a recent report to the Royal Knights has reignited previously subdued tension. 

The 'Gnoll' tribe, which is part of the Fomor Force, has been spotted in the Northern Ruins. 


The Gnoll tribe, with whom you fought fierce battles during the Pre-Alpha test last March, usually roams around the Fomor territories in search of prey. 

According to a recent report from the Kalbram Mercenaries, the Gnolls in the Northern Ruins seem to be setting up a base, like they're planning to settle there. 
  

What could be the Gnolls' purpose? 

Is this movement a signal from the Unified Fomor Forces to resume the war? 

The Royal Knights are on high alert, closely watching the Northern Ruins. 
  

As the tension of war looms more than ever, are you ready to face the upcoming battles? 


We look forward to seeing how your efforts will shape the future. 

See you soon in the next Dev Log. 

Thank you. 
 

[i][b]<Vindictus: Defying Fate> Dev Team  [/b][/i]

notes.title: June Dev Log
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Mercenaries.[/h3]

Time flies by, and summer is just around the corner. 

In today’s June Dev Log, we’d like to briefly introduce you to the basic background of our game. 

Let’s take a look at the town where you begin your journey and the Mercenary Corps you’ll belong to in [i]Vindictus: Defying Fate[/i]. 


[b][h3]1. Colhen, where the story begins   [/h3][/b]
We introduce Colhen, the village where your adventure begins. 

This humble village, located near the frontlines, suffered great damage from the United Fomor Force serving the Demon Lord in the past. 

Afterward, the Royal Knights realized the need for enhanced security. This led to their decision to establish a new Mercenary Corps, and during the process of stationing them in various base areas, Colhen was included. 

The village, once brutally trampled, is now being protected by the Kalbram Mercenary Corps led by Captain Aidan. You can feel the unique atmosphere of Colhen, where civilian houses and military facilities coexist, creating a blend of peace and tension. 
 
[b][View of Colhen]  [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/6dbdba1dd9478682f0668be289b1b4e8d1b57293.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/a6356e3acb890cfb9a75eb732397c77fe9ce256e.jpg[/img]
Please note that the visuals are subject to change. 


[b][h3]2. The Mercenary Corps[/h3][/b]
The Rocheste Royal Knights Regular Mercenary Corps, also known as the “Kalbram Mercenary Corps,” is stationed in Colhen by the order of the Royal Knights to maintain security in the village and the nearby frontline areas. 

As a member of the Kalbram Mercenary Corps, you will navigate through the story of Vindictus: Defying Fate. 

  
[b][The name, ‘Kalbram’] [/b]

Kalbram was originally the name of Colhen’s Vigilance Committee. 

As the war between humans and Fomors dragged on and the Royal Knights’ forces dwindled, the residents of Colhen devised a self-defense measure to protect themselves from the security vacuum. 

However, ordinary villagers like farmers and blacksmiths were not enough to defend themselves from the Fomors’ attacks. When the day came that the Fomors attacked Colhen, most of the Kalbram vigilantes lost their lives. 

Later, Captain Aidan named the Mercenary Corps after the Vigilance Committee to honor their noble patriotism. 
  

[b][The Kalbram Mercenary Outfits]  [/b]

Mercenary Corps’ uniforms focus on practicality rather than style. 

All Mercenaries are required to wear the Mercenary Uniform as part of the regular units of the Knights. But due to the unique nature of their employment contracts, many still prefer to wear their own outfits. 

However, Mercenaries still have to carry a badge indicating their affiliation with the Kalbram Mercenaries if they’re wearing casual outfits. 

Below is the concept artwork of the Mercenary Uniforms, in development. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/d8fd2fd949654f5f418fd3d4a5029e636c1a2708.jpg[/img]


As the last Dev Log introduced you to our recent development status, we wanted to go into the lore of VDF this time, which was not originally revealed during the Pre-Alpha phase. 

We sincerely thank everyone for your interest and affection towards the game. 

Our development team will do our best to make up for your support. 

We look forward to seeing you in the next Dev Log. 


Thank you. 

[i][b]<Vindictus: Defying Fate> Development Team   [/b][/i]

notes.title: General Gameplay Guide
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Mercenaries, this is <[i]Vindictus: Defying Fate[/i]> team.  [/h3]

Prior to the start of our pre-alpha test, we’d like to briefly introduce our gameplay guide and contents. 


[h3][b]< About the playtest > [/b][/h3]

The key point of this pre-alpha test is our combat systems. 

During the testing period, you’ll be able to choose between two characters of your taste. 
[olist]
[*] [b]Fiona, a swordman who uses a one-handed sword and a shield  [/b]
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2814860/announcements/detail/4124805233774949765]Fiona’s Controls & Combat Guide [/url]
[*] [b]Lann, a warrior who uses a pair of swords  [/b]
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2814860/announcements/detail/4124805233774947639]Lann’s Controls & Combat Guide [/url]
[/olist]
All characters utilize [b]'Normal Attacks'[/b] and [b]'Strong Attacks'[/b],both which you can combine to create various combo attacks.  

Furthermore, each character has four of their own [b]'Active Skills'[/b] and [b]'Dodge'[/b] feature.
Once you master our [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2814860/announcements/detail/4124805233777514198]Basic Guide on Combat[/url][/b], you’ll be able to enjoy our gameplay more.

There are currently two playable fields at the moment: The [b]Northern Ruins[/b] and the [b]Frozen Valley[/b]. 

At the very first run, you’ll only be able to move to the[b] Frozen Valley[/b] upon completion of the [b]Northern Ruins[/b].

You will be able to select battle fields you wish to play after clearing the [b]Northern Ruins[/b]. 
[olist]
[*] [b]Northern Ruins 
[/b][*] [b]Frozen Valley [/b]
[/olist]
Among various Monsters you encounter during your play, [i][b]Boss Monsters[/b][/i] have [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2814860/announcements/detail/4124805233792338157]Unique Attack Patterns[/url][/b] other than Normal Attacks. 

Please note that these special attacks are either unable to guard against, or unable to evade. 



[h3][b]< Gameplay features > [/b][/h3]

[b]> Camp  [/b]

You can restore your HP and items used during battles at the [b]camp[/b]. 

These [b]camps[/b] emit a blue light pillar on the map for you to see.
By using[b] [E][/b] for the keyboard, you can activate the camp.[list]
[*] [b]Key features [/b]
[/list][olist]
[*] You can rest to restore your HP and used items.  
[*] By clicking on the camp icon on the map, you can teleport between activated camps. 
[*] If you get killed in action, the game will restart from the previous camp point. 
[/olist]
[b]> Game modes  [/b]

You can experience two different game modes in this pre-alpha test: 

One is a [b]'Normal Mode'[/b], where you can use HP potion item during your gameplay, and the other is the [b]+(Plus) Mode[/b], where you won’t be able to use any items. 

The plus mode will only be unlocked after completion of all the fields and bosses in Normal Mode. 
[list]
[*] [b][F1] on Keyboard[/b]: Guide on gameplay basics
[*] [b][F2] on Keyboard[/b]: Character play guide 
[/list]
[b]> Pre-alpha test playable contents [/b]

You can access various character [b]Outfits[/b] and[b] Emotes[/b] in the [b]game menu([ESC] Key)[/b] for free, and you can use the [b]Photo Mode[/b] to take screenshots with different views.  

These contents are all temporary only for the pre-alpha test, and there may be changes during following development processes. 
[olist]
[*] [b]Outfits[/b]: You can try on some test outfits. Currently we do not offer combinations of outfit parts, but we are planning to add the feature in the future. 
[*] [b]Emotes[/b]: All Emotes are for testing purposes and are irrelevant to the individual characters’ concept or personality.
[*] [b]Photo Mode[/b]: Currently the mechanism is minimized, and only has basic features. 
[/olist]


[h3][b]<About the Characters > [/b][/h3]

All characters in [i][b]<Vindictus: Defying Fate>[/b][/i] offer distinct action styles tailored to each character, each with their own unique sense of impact and speed.

We recommend you to choose any character of your taste to have the best play experience. 

During this pre-alpha test, only two characters:[b] Fiona[/b] and [b]Lann[/b], will be playable.  

However, we plan to add more characters with further development. 



[h3][b]< Gamepad controls > [/b][/h3]

You can play with a keyboard and mouse. 

But since the game was developed based on [b]gamepad play[/b], we also support gamepad controls from the pre-alpha stage. 

The game is currently compatible with Xbox controllers and controller vibration features are to be updated in the future. 

 

Thank you.

[h3][b][Character Attack][/b][/h3]

There are two types of attacks available to characters: [b]‘Normal Attacks'[/b]’ and [b]‘Strong Attacks’[/b]

[b]Normal Attacks[/b] deal moderate damage but has a fast attack speed, making it easy to engage in combat.  
[b]Strong Attacks[/b], on the other hand, deals higher damage but has a slower attack speed, making it more suitable for finishing off enemies. 


[h3][b][Utilizing Normal and Strong Attacks][/b][/h3]

You can conduct various [i][b]combo attacks[/b][/i] by combining [b]Normal and Strong Attacks[/b]. 
For each situation and enemy, chain suitable combo attacks to engage with higher effectiveness.

notes.title: Vindictus: Defying Fate public pre-Alpha test arrives soon, offering a glimpse into Nexon's upcoming medieval fantasy adventure
notes.content:
Nexon will host a public pre-alpha test for Vindictus: Defying Fate, the action RPG the company announced earlier this week.

Set in a fantasy world inspired by Celtic mythology, the game takes place in the same realm as Nexon’s 2010 MMORPG, Vindictus, expanding on its world and lore with immersive environments covering everything from dungeons to desolate landscapes, and it boasts plenty of fast-paced combat.

Featuring a large roster with distinct characters to choose from, including Vindictus series favorites Lann and Fiona, you will find each choice comes with unique abilities and combos, which will aid you against Fomorian creatures based on classic Irish mythology and the more challenging enemies that dwarf your size.

Read more

notes.title: (UPDATED) FAQ
notes.content:
[h2]▶ About Game[/h2]

[h3]Q:  I'd like to know about the pre-alpha test schedule.  [/h3]
[quote][b][Pre-Alpha Test Schedule][/b]   
[list]
[*] March 13th, 2024 18:00 ~ March 18th, 2024 1:00 (PDT)

[h3]Q: Can I still play the game when my PC specification does not meet the minimum system requirements?  [/h3]  
[quote]A: The minimum system requirements are the PC specifications that allow you to play [i][b]<Vindictus: Defying Fate>[/b][/i] pre-alpha test comfortably, but you will still be able to play the game even if some PC specifications are low. 
You may have to change the game settings to the environment that works for your PC specifications when playing the game. [/quote] 

[h3]Q: Can I play with Steam Deck?  [/h3]  
[quote]A: The pre-alpha test cannot be played on Steam Deck. [/quote] 

[h3]Q: Is the pre-alpha released globally?  [/h3] 
[quote]A: The pre-alpha test will be serviced globally, there may be some limited regions in the official launch. 
More detailed information will be available at the time of launch.  [/quote]

[h3]Q: How can I report a bug?  [/h3] 
[quote]A: If you have any issues with the pre-alpha test, please report them through the following channel. 
[olist]
[*] Log onto the [url=https://discord.gg/vdefyingfate]Official Discord[/url]
[*] Select [i]#feedback-reports[/i] Channel
